project.name: sensorica_blueprint
project.description: End-to-end sensing, digitization, and IoT telemetry architecture for ESP32 with PlatformIO, Wokwi simulation, and Cloudflare/Nodrix integration.

nodes.name: main.cpp
nodes.summary: Main firmware entry point initializing ADC sensors and IoT telemetry, executing the periodic sampling and publishing loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Arduino-framework entry point defining setup() and loop() routines with non-blocking timing.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Initializes serial logging, configures ADC1 sensor pins, and connects WiFi telemetry.

nodes.name: loop
nodes.summary: Executes network maintenance and periodically polls ADC sensor readings to publish telemetry to the cloud.

nodes.name: telemetry.h
nodes.summary: Header defining public telemetry interface functions for WiFi initialization, network maintenance, and sensor data dispatch.

nodes.name: telemetry.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements HTTPS telemetry communication using persistent TLS keep-alive connections to publish serialized sensor JSON payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses persistent WiFiClientSecure and HTTPClient with TLS session reuse and ArduinoJson payload serialization.

nodes.name: connect_wifi_fast
nodes.summary: Connects to the WiFi access point with an optimized channel scan for Wokwi-GUEST and fallback for standard networks.

nodes.name: telemetry_init
nodes.summary: Configures persistent TLS client options, sets HTTP headers, and initiates the initial WiFi network connection.

nodes.name: telemetry_run
nodes.summary: Monitors WiFi connectivity status and attempts reconnection at 5-second intervals if disconnected.

nodes.name: telemetry_is_connected
nodes.summary: Checks whether the ESP32 WiFi station interface is currently connected to an access point.

nodes.name: telemetry_publish
nodes.summary: Serializes sensor data to JSON and transmits an HTTPS POST request over a persistent TLS connection.

nodes.name: acondicionamiento.md
nodes.summary: Technical documentation explaining sensor signal conditioning, ESP32 ADC1 constraints, virtual potentiometer simulation in Wokwi, and analog front-end design for real sensors.

nodes.name: implementation_plan.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step implementation guide covering Wokwi simulation, ESP32 firmware acquisition, Cloudflare Nodrix backend deployment, and MCP-driven telemetry dashboard setup.

nodes.name: plan.md
nodes.summary: Master project plan describing architecture decisions, hardware/simulation configurations, and milestone verification from sensor acquisition to cloud dashboard.

nodes.name: diagram.json
nodes.summary: Wokwi simulation circuit layout defining an ESP32 DevKit v4 connected to three potentiometers simulating temperature, humidity, and light sensors.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON schema specifying parts layout and pin-to-pin wiring connections for Wokwi virtual ESP32 hardware simulation.

nodes.name: platformio.ini
nodes.summary: PlatformIO configuration file for ESP32 target development, defining board settings, Arduino framework, upload/monitor baud rates, and external library dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: INI format configuration specifying the espressif32 platform, esp32dev board, and libraries including Nodrix and ArduinoJson.

nodes.name: wokwi.toml
nodes.summary: Wokwi simulation configuration file specifying the relative paths to the compiled ESP32 firmware binary and ELF files generated by PlatformIO.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive architectural overview and guide covering sensor signal acquisition, ESP32 ADC1 digitization, Wokwi simulation, and real-time Cloudflare/Nodrix IoT telemetry.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the sensor monitoring dashboard in Nodrix, detailing its 16-column grid layout, widget inventory, and variable mapping.

nodes.name: monitoreo_sensores.json
nodes.summary: Exported Nodrix dashboard configuration specifying widget layouts for instantaneous values, analog gauges, and historical telemetry charts.

nodes.name: config.h
nodes.summary: Firmware configuration header defining ESP32 ADC1 pins, telemetry timing, baud rates, HTTP/TLS timeouts, and physical sensor scaling boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses C++ constexpr for compile-time hardware pin definitions and scaling parameters.

nodes.name: secrets.h.example
nodes.summary: Template configuration file defining placeholders for WiFi network credentials, Nodrix Cloudflare Worker hostname, and project authentication tokens.

nodes.name: sensors.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements ADC initialization and physical magnitude calculation from ESP32 12-bit ADC readings.

nodes.name: sensors_init
nodes.summary: Configures ESP32 ADC1 resolution to 12 bits, attenuation to 11 dB, and sets up GPIO input pins for sensor channels.

nodes.name: sensors_read
nodes.summary: Reads raw 12-bit values from ADC1 channels and applies linear interpolation formulas to return structured SensorData.

nodes.name: sensors.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring sensor data structures (SensorReading, SensorData) and function prototypes for ADC setup and sampling.

tour.title: Architecture & Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the complete sensorica_blueprint system architecture spanning simulated sensing, ESP32 ADC digitization, and Cloudflare Nodrix cloud telemetry. It details the end-to-end data pipeline, repository structure, and physical channel mapping.
tour.languageLesson: Markdown documents with embedded Mermaid diagrams allow architectural blueprints to evolve synchronously with code in version control.

tour.title: Signal Conditioning & Circuit Setup
tour.description: Before reading firmware code, understand how hardware signals are acquired and simulated. These files document analog front-end conditioning constraints—explaining why ESP32 ADC1 is strictly chosen over ADC2 to coexist with WiFi—and map virtual potentiometers to GPIOs in the Wokwi circuit layout.
tour.languageLesson: Wokwi diagram.json declarations model breadboard wiring, component part numbers, and pin connections for deterministic simulation without physical lab hardware.

tour.title: Build Configuration & Emulation
tour.description: Connecting the circuit simulation to compilation, these configuration files define the PlatformIO build environment and Wokwi runtime bridge. They specify the Espressif 32 platform, Arduino framework, upload speed, and the compiled binary targets executed in the emulator.
tour.languageLesson: PlatformIO uses INI-formatted platformio.ini files to isolate target microcontrollers, framework versions, and external library dependencies.

tour.title: Firmware Parameters & Credentials
tour.description: Building on the hardware definitions from Step 2, config.h defines ADC1 pin constants, physical magnitude conversion boundaries, and telemetry dispatch intervals. The secrets template provides secure placeholders for WiFi credentials and Nodrix Cloudflare endpoints without exposing private tokens in version control.
tour.languageLesson: Header guards (#ifndef / #define) prevent duplicate symbol declarations in C/C++, while .example template files prevent accidental commits of production secrets.

tour.title: ADC Acquisition & Conversion
tour.description: This core module implements the 12-bit ADC digitization and linear scaling logic defined in config.h. It declares the SensorReading and SensorData structures, providing clean, strongly typed representations of temperature, humidity, and illumination for upstream consumption.
tour.languageLesson: C++ structs encapsulate multi-channel sensor readings into cohesive data objects, separating hardware acquisition logic from networking code.

tour.title: Network Transport & Telemetry
tour.description: With sensor readings structured in Step 5, the telemetry subsystem manages WiFi connectivity and formats payloads for cloud delivery. It establishes persistent TLS keep-alive connections over HTTPS to serialize sensor data as JSON and dispatch it to the Nodrix Cloudflare Worker API.
tour.languageLesson: Reusing persistent TLS sessions with WiFiClientSecure avoids expensive cryptographic handshakes on every periodic HTTP POST, preserving embedded CPU cycles and memory.

tour.title: Main Firmware Application Loop
tour.description: The main entry point ties together sensor sampling from Step 5 and telemetry dispatch from Step 6. Operating inside Arduino's setup and loop lifecycle, it initializes hardware, periodically captures sensor data, verifies network health, and handles transmission error recovery.
tour.languageLesson: Non-blocking time comparisons using millis() allow embedded applications to schedule periodic tasks without halting CPU execution via delay().

tour.title: Real-Time Telemetry Dashboard
tour.description: Completing the end-to-end architecture introduced in Step 1, this step covers the Cloudflare Nodrix visualization dashboard. It specifies widget coordinates, historical time-series charts, and gauge monitors bound to the sensor variables emitted by the ESP32 firmware.
tour.languageLesson: Declarative JSON layouts define frontend widget geometries and API data mappings cleanly separated from presentation rendering logic.
